REST API for the TruVideo omnichannel video-and-messaging platform for service businesses (built for the automotive service market: dealers, service advisors, technicians, repair orders and customers). Covers authentication, users, dealers, repair orders, videos, messaging conversations, customers, files, in-app chat, reporting and support. Faithfully reconstructed from TruVideo's published API documentation (github.com/Truvideo/Documentation); TruVideo does not publish a machine readable OpenAPI definition of its own.
